softwareSource
Gets a list of Entitlements

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the compartment. This parameter is required and returns only resources contained within the specified compartment.

params.name: csi
params.description: A filter to return entitlements that match the given customer support identifier (CSI).

params.name: vendorName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given vendor name.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `3`

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort entitlements by. Only one sort order may be provided.

params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the compartment. This parameter is required and returns only resources contained within the specified compartment.

params.name: name
params.description:
The assigned erratum name. It's unique and not changeable.

Example: `ELSA-2020-5804`

params.name: nameContains
params.description: A filter to return resources that may partially match the erratum name given.

params.name: classificationType
params.description: A filter to return only packages that match the given update classification type.

params.name: advisoryType
params.description: A filter to return only errata that match the given advisory types.

params.name: osFamily
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given operating system family.

params.name: advisorySeverity
params.description: The advisory severity.

params.name: timeIssueDateStart
params.description:
The issue date after which to list all errata, in ISO 8601 format

Example: 2017-07-14T02:40:00.000Z

params.name: timeIssueDateEnd
params.description:
The issue date before which to list all errata, in ISO 8601 format

Example: 2017-07-14T02:40:00.000Z

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `3`

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

info.name: Removes packages from a software source.

params.name: softwareSourceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the software source.

items.docs:
Removes packages from a software source. This operation can only be done for custom software sources that are not created using filters.
Packages can be of the format:
  * name (for example: git). This removes all versions of the package.
  * name-version-release.architecture (for example: git-2.43.5-1.el8_10.x86_64)
  * name-epoch:version-release.architecture (for example: git-0:2.43.5-1.el8_10.x86_64)

items.docs:
